_meta.description: Authoritative Massachusetts regional taxonomy for the Carevero MA foundation. 10 consumer-facing regions covering all 14 MA counties. Nine counties map 1:1 to a region (county-based, unambiguous). The five eastern metro counties (Suffolk, Middlesex, Essex, Norfolk, Plymouth) subdivide into metro regions by municipality; a per-county default plus an explicit city gazetteer resolves them. This taxonomy is IDENTITY/geography only — no pricing, nothing consumer-published. Validated against the CMS Hospital General Information snapshot (data/ma_cms_hospital_snapshot.json, dataset xubh-q36u, retrieved 2026-08-18) via scripts/verify_ma_foundation.py: every hospital in the denominator resolves to its assigned region from (county, city).

municipal_overrides._note: Cross-boundary municipal exceptions checked BEFORE county rules. MA municipality names are unique statewide, so a bare city key is unambiguous. Milford is in Worcester County but is an I-495/MetroWest-belt town and is grouped with MetroWest (curated assignment).

eastern_metro_counties._note: Suffolk/Middlesex/Essex/Norfolk/Plymouth span more than one metro region, so a county default is combined with a municipality gazetteer. `default_region` applies when a municipality is not listed in `city_overrides`. The gazetteer is authoritative for every facility currently in the denominator and is extended per-municipality as non-hospital facilities are added in later phases (never guessed at publish time).
